name: pi-afk-runner
description: An AFK queue runner: takes a ready-for-agent issue, works it in an isolated worktree, and opens a reviewed pull request.

scripts.build: npx --package=typescript@5.6.3 -y tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --eval "require('fs').cpSync('src/prompts','dist/prompts',{recursive:true})" && node scripts/build-info.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npx --package=typescript@5.6.3 -y tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx --package=typescript@5.6.3 -y tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
